properties.name: Szent László város — belső forráscella
properties.sourceScopeNote: The two-hole CENTRAL source cell labelled Szent László város, excluding the separate Muszáj and Kósafalu cells. It is not the complete Szent László Város district named in the caption and prose; no independent fine-neighborhood scope is asserted.
properties.method: Literal decimal m/l paths from the original municipal PDF Figure 77 Form stream. Only original nonzero line segments are polygonized, independently per source stroke object; no noding, buffer, repair, snap, simplification, image-frame closure or invented connecting edge. The central source cell retains both original holes. Six manually interpreted historical-map road junctions and literal current OSM-node coordinates fit an affine transform in EOV/EPSG:23700; a candidate southern road-junction/cycleway attachment is held out, with physical identity unconfirmed. Geographic placement is an explicit unverified estimate. Source contours are transformed to WGS84 without replacing them by current roads.
properties.license: Municipal source-map reuse rights unverified; ODbL-1.0 for OSM geographical controls and name points.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2021 May municipal consultation draft; underlying orthophoto date unknown.
properties.attribution: Source: Kecskemét MJV Megalapozó Vizsgálat II, May 2021 consultation draft, Figure 77; geographical controls ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
reviewNotes: Every contour edge is an original native PDF line segment, including original portions beyond the displayed map crop.
Map registration uses manual source junction interpretation. Residuals and a held-out visual match do not calibrate absolute boundary accuracy.
Industrial function alone is not grounds for discarding a source-named cell; its documented local/economic scope is retained.
The source-map reuse license, current exact boundary extent, legal status and address assignment remain unverified.
